Market today: The mood is cautious, driven by significant uncertainty around Nvidia's leadership and the broader AI sector. Rising Treasury yields also add pressure to growth-oriented tech names. This directly impacts your heavily concentrated tech and chip portfolio.

Your holdings: SOXL (-70.62%), MUU (-49.58%), and SPAL (-45.57%) are showing severe drawdowns, amplified by their leveraged nature. SMH (-20.34%) and SMCI (-30.65%) also need close attention. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on any further developments regarding Nvidia's CEO and the impact on the AI narrative. Also, monitor Treasury yields for continued upward pressure.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management and consider reducing exposure to your most volatile, deeply underwater leveraged positions amidst this uncertainty.
plays: Review SOXL (-70.62%) and MUU (-49.58%) stops; their deep losses and leveraged nature are a major concern, especially with chip sector uncertainty.
Consider trimming SMH (-20.34%) given the Nvidia news directly impacting the semiconductor sector.
